FADE IN:

INT. OFFICE - DAY

A cluttered desk. Papers everywhere. JOHN (40s, tired eyes) stares at a monitor.

MARY (30s, sharp suit) enters, drops a folder on the desk.

                    MARY
          We need to talk about the Henderson file.

John doesn't look up.

                    JOHN
          I know. I've been working on it all night.

Mary sits across from him. Tension.

                    MARY
          The client is coming in at three.

John finally looks at her. A beat.

                    JOHN
          I'll have it ready.

CUT TO:

INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - LATER

A long table. The HENDERSON CLIENT (50s, stern) sits at the head.

John presents. Mary watches from the corner.

                    HENDERSON CLIENT
          This is exactly what we didn't want.

John's face falls. Mary steps forward.

                    MARY
          We can revise by end of day.

The client considers. Nods slowly.

                    HENDERSON CLIENT
          You have until five.

FADE OUT.
